name: Standards Mismatch MCP
summary: MCP server entry whose _meta.ga4gh_standards claims a standard not present in the common core's ga4gh_standards.
description: Schema-valid on its own (both arrays are well-formed), but violates the D14 cross-field subset rule scripts/validate.ts enforces: stripping @<version> from server._meta["org.ga4gh/ai-registry"].ga4gh_standards[] must yield a subset of the common core's ga4gh_standards[]. Here the core only names "trs" but the server claims to implement "beacon" as well.

server.name: org.ga4gh/standards-mismatch-mcp
server.description: Claims to implement beacon without naming it in the core facet.
